name: Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV)
description: Premier Chinese SARS-related coronavirus research center. BSL-4 facility. Extensive bat CoV work including RaTG13 and chimeric constructs under EcoHealth collaboration.
sources: Peer-reviewed papers, grant reports, ODNI, facilities card

name: Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market
description: Early case cluster location. Environmental samples later tested positive for SARS-CoV-2. Live mammals present.

name: EcoHealth Alliance (NY HQ)
description: U.S. nonprofit that received NIH funding and subawarded bat coronavirus work to WIV. Later debarred by HHS.

name: NIH / NIAID (Bethesda)
description: Primary U.S. funder of the EcoHealth–WIV bat coronavirus work under Fauci.

name: USAMRIID / Fort Detrick
description: U.S. Army BSL-4. Defensive biodefense mission. Comparative node to WIV. 2019 CDC select-agent suspension.

name: Galveston National Laboratory
description: NIAID National Biocontainment Laboratory (BSL-4). Documented formal collaboration/training relationship with WIV.

name: NEIDL (Boston University)
description: Second NIAID National Biocontainment Laboratory. BSL-4 approved 2017.

name: NIAID IRF-Frederick
description: NIAID Integrated Research Facility at Fort Detrick. Part of intramural high-containment cluster.

name: Rocky Mountain Laboratories (RML)
description: NIAID Rocky Mountain Laboratories (Hamilton, MT). High-containment research.
